# Reference: ABS Module Connector Pinout Variations

## Summary

[Partial] Inspect the back of the switch connector to identify pin positions. [t38]

## Tips & gotchas

- The middle row left and right pins are used for a 'button up' (flush) configuration where ABS functions normally. [t38]
- For a 'button down' configuration, use the middle pin paired with either the left or right pin. [t38]
